description: Interface definition for Drupal's StreamWrapperManager, providing methods for managing and querying stream wrappers, including registration, retrieval, normalization, and validation of stream schemes and URIs.

classes.name: StreamWrapperManagerInterface
classes.description: Defines the interface for managing Drupal stream wrappers, including registration, retrieval, and validation methods.

methods.name: getWrappers
methods.description: Returns an array of registered stream wrappers, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getNames
methods.description: Returns an array of registered stream wrapper names, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns descriptions of registered stream wrappers, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getViaScheme
methods.description: Returns a stream wrapper object for a given scheme.

methods.name: getViaUri
methods.description: Returns a stream wrapper object for a given URI.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for a given scheme.

methods.name: registerWrapper
methods.description: Registers a new stream wrapper with PHP.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Extracts the target part of a URI after the scheme.

methods.name: normalizeUri
methods.description: Normalizes a URI to a standard format.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Extracts the scheme from a URI.

methods.name: isValidScheme
methods.description: Checks if a scheme has a registered and callable handler.

methods.name: isValidUri
methods.description: Checks if a URI has a valid scheme for file API operations.
